Midnight Breeze is born from the inspiration of cool desert nights under a canopy of stars. Dark, smoky and intensely masculine — this fragrance captures the stillness of a desert midnight, mysterious and unforgettable.

Crafted for the man who moves with quiet confidence, Midnight Breeze opens with a bold rush of Pink Pepper and Sweet Orange before settling into a deep, woody heart of Secret Oud and Cedar.
